# Module: Startup logic and config-driven content

**Goal:** Prepare the app before first render, run one build in every environment, and render pages and forms from JSON.

About 6 hours. Do the steps in order; skip steps marked for the other track.

## 1. Study the code: README: "Startup logic" and "Config-driven content" sections

- [ ] Done · Both tracks · about 20 min
- Files: [`README.md`](../../README.md)
- Look for: How startup is ordered, why config is fetched at runtime, the JSON page contract and the four steps to add a section type.
- Concepts: Startup logic and runtime config, Config-driven pages and forms

## 2. Explore in the app: Concepts Lab: Startup and config

- [ ] Done · Both tracks · about 60 min
- Open in the running app: `http://localhost:4200/lab/startup`
- Files: [`src/app/core/startup/app-init.service.ts`](../../src/app/core/startup/app-init.service.ts), [`src/app/core/config/app-config.service.ts`](../../src/app/core/config/app-config.service.ts), [`src/app/core/config/parse-app-config.ts`](../../src/app/core/config/parse-app-config.ts), [`public/config/app-config.json`](../../public/config/app-config.json)
- Look for: Ordered, timed steps; HttpBackend skipping interceptors; injector.get() after config loads; defaults when the file is missing. Try it: turn conceptsLab off in app-config.json and reload.
